personalInfo.statement: Hi, my name is Aaron Reyes. I'm a junior at UNC Charlotte majoring in Computer Science with a concentration in AI, Robotics & Gaming, and a minor in Mathematics. Outside of class I run my own supplement brand, and I'm working toward a career in AI sales. I'm looking forward to building real web projects this semester.
personalInfo.personalBackground: I'm originally from New York and moved to Charlotte for school.
personalInfo.professionalBackground: I hold an active real estate license and have a background in real estate sales. I also founded and run Radiant Roots, a supplement brand, which I handle end to end: product, content, and sales.
personalInfo.academicBackground: Computer Science, B.S. at UNC Charlotte, concentration in AI, Robotics & Gaming, minor in Mathematics. Junior, graduating in 2028.
personalInfo.alternateComputerLocation: A campus computer at Atkins Library.

courses.reasonForTaking: Major requirement, and I want to be able to build and ship a functional website on my own.
Core security course for my degree, and a solid foundation for understanding how systems get broken.
I'm interested in the human side of security: why people ignore warnings and make risky choices even when the tech works.
Required for my degree; I want to understand what's happening underneath the code I write.
